name: tpl-responded-existence-2-goal
task: If you move the ball, you must also take the key. Then pick up the box in the other room.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The clauses match the task exactly. 'If you move the ball, you must also take the key' is the hard RespondedExistence(blocker_moved, has_door_key); 'Then pick up the box in the other room' yields Existence(target_picked_up), Precedence(has_door_key, target_picked_up), and Response(blocker_moved, target_picked_up), as required for a command after Then following a conditional. R1 is listed as redundant, but it is stated by the task's own 'if' sentence, so it stays; R2-R4 are not redundant. No preference cues, so all hard is correct.

texts: If the ball is moved, the matching door key must also be taken at some point.
Pick up the target box in the other room.
Pick up the target box only after taking the matching door key.
If the ball is moved, the target box must be picked up at or after that time.
